name: MetallicPaint-TS-TW

frames.best_why: Frame 1 shows the largest liquid swirl with warm orange refraction near the tip.

tagline: A chrome star shape ripples like molten metal.
summary: A four-pointed sparkle silhouette filled with liquid chrome, its highlights, dark pools and rainbow edges sliding around inside the shape.
appearance: A sharp four-pointed star on black, its interior a mirror-bright silver with dark liquid patches and thin warm orange edges. Highlights pool near the middle and smeared streaks run out to the tips.
behaviour: The metal pattern drifts inside the fixed silhouette, so highlights swell, dark blobs wander and faint rainbow fringes slide across the surface. The star outline itself never moves.
search_phrases: metallic paint on an svg shape
iridescent liquid fill for a logo
use_when: A logo or icon should look like polished liquid metal in a hero or brand moment.
avoid_when: It reads only the alpha of a flat silhouette, so photos and detailed marks come out wrong.
customise: The shape is an image URL, with seed, scale, speed, brightness, liquid, refraction, blur, contrast, light and dark colours and a tint as props.
weight_why: A single shader quad is redrawn each frame, plus a one-off image depth pass of 200 iterations.

a11y.note: The canvas has no accessible name or text alternative, and the metal keeps moving regardless of motion preferences.

issues: Inside the tall thin points the liquid texture is hard to read against the black.
There is no reduced-motion handling and no text alternative for the canvas.
polish_why: Convincing liquid chrome with warm edge tints; the fixed star shape limits the effect.
title: Metallic Paint Shader
